messages:
emily.prod: Quick sync: we need a tight plan for the tenant-gated rollout of model-pin + graceful degrade. This is customer-driven (Nora's EMEA list) so low blast radius and clear tenant-level controls. Thoughts on slices and safety gates?

samir.p: Suggestion: opt-in slices per tenant with explicit boolean + version pin. rollout levels: <0.1% (smoke) -> 1% -> 10% -> full. Keep each stage max 36h unless metrics look great.

nora.cs: Confirming 3 customers: GreenLeaf, OrbitFinance, and HelixTech. They require explicit opt-in and a manual rollback option in the console. Also ask for an email opt-out confirmation in the early phase.

andre.r: Telemetry checklist: per-tenant p50/p90/p99, 5m error rate, tokens-per-request, and cost-per-1k-tokens. Gates: if p99 > baseline + 120ms OR error rate increase > 0.3pp -> pause stage.

tess.ops: Infra: pre-warm KV cache 20m before each stage. Add an autoscale cushion for first 10m. Also we should run a short synthetic correctness test (top-1 match) per tenant after each bump.

emily.prod: Experiments: A) thin-model fallback vs mid-model fallback (see cost/latency). B) cache-enabled small cohort vs cache-disabled. Minimum: 25k requests/arm OR 24h. We'll randomize at tenant-request level for non-dedicated customers.

deploy-bot: scheduled-deploy: canary-1 -> 2026-05-14T02:00:00Z, canary-2 -> 2026-05-14T04:30:00Z

samir.p: Policy language: two flags per tenant: `pin.version` (string) and `rollout.slice` (string). Example in UI/CLI: ```json
{"pin.version": "2026-05-v2", "rollout.slice": "greenleaf-early"}```

andre.r: Fallback behavior: when overloaded or memory pressure -> serve thin-model with header `X-Redwood-Fallback: thin` and emit event `fallback.tenant=<tenant> reason=<reason>`. Tenants can disable automatic fallback with `fallback.automatic=false`.

nora.cs: Customers will want to opt-out of automatic fallback. We'll document tradeoffs (higher error risk) and include a checkbox during opt-in.

tess.ops: Rollback triggers (automated): sustained p99 > baseline +200ms for 8m OR error rate > 0.6% for 3m OR synthetic probe fail rate > 5% for 10m -> immediate rollback to pinned version and page SRE. Manual kill switch: product can flip `rollout.slice` to "off" per tenant.

emily.prod: Communication: prepare template for opt-in invite, rollback FAQ, and degraded-mode behavior. Nora please collect legal/contract asks for EMEA tenants.

andre.r: Observability: add per-tenant tile showing current slice, pin.version, last rollback, and cumulative cost delta. Also annotate timestamps when fallback events occur.

samir.p: One more: limit experiment exposure for a tenant to one active experiment at a time. If a tenant has dedicated infra, respect their pin and do not randomize.

emily.prod: Ops checklist before smoke: 1) pre-warm script uploaded 2) feature flag enabled in staging 3) opt-in email sent to GreenLeaf 4) verify synthetic probe baseline 5) deploy canary-1. Owners: Tess 1+4, Samir 2+5, Nora 3.

deploy-bot: runbook-created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-pin-rollout-2026-05 :white_check_mark:

emily.prod: Let's reconvene tomorrow 15:00 UTC to sign off on the pre-warm. If no blockers, I'll publish the playbook by EOD. Thanks!
